title: What If You Stood on 55 Cancri e, a Planet Covered in Lava?

scenes.text: What if you stood on a planet where one year is shorter than a day on Earth?
55 Cancri e is a super-Earth about 40 light-years away, roughly twice Earth's size.
It circles its star in about 18 hours, far closer than Mercury is to our Sun.
One side may always face the star, with day-side temperatures near 3,000 kelvin.
Rivers and lakes of magma could cover that side. The night side is still near 1,400 kelvin.
Hotter than the melting point of rock on both sides. There is nowhere to stand.

description:
What if you stood on 55 Cancri e?
This rocky world 40 light-years away orbits in about 18 hours, and its day side may be a sea of magma.
What should we run through next?
